property_summary: For any role and any target account, a caller other than the target itself must not be able to renounce the target's role: reference renounceRole reverts whenever msg.sender != callerConfirmation, while the mutant silently revokes anyone's role and succeeds.
change_summary: Remove the guard so any caller can revoke `role` from an arbitrary `callerConfirmation` account, allowing unauthorized revocation of other users' roles.
